items.text: Status bookmark selection (colorize off) — bookmarks with ping/status monitoring now highlight the full row on hover and keyboard selection even when Change bookmark color when offline is disabled in Config. Previously only the ms badge lit up in that mode.
Modern + side rail — with layout Modern and button bar Side rail (left), navigation no longer appears twice (same fix as Glass in v2026.06.30).

Status colorize help — the ℹ tooltip on Change bookmark color when offline now explains that hover and keyboard selection always use the normal row highlight; the option only affects idle offline/checking row colors.

Production Docker Compose — docker-compose.prod.yml mounts only ./data; CSS and templates come from the image so production deploys match the built release (use docker-compose.yml for dev with live static mounts).
